title: Rod Cutting
statement: `prices[i]` is the price of a rod piece of length i + 1. Return the maximum revenue from cutting a rod of length `n` into pieces. Not cutting is allowed. n equals len(prices).
hints: This is unbounded knapsack. A length can be used many times.
dp[L] is the best revenue for a rod of length L.
dp[L] = max over piece length p <= L of prices[p - 1] + dp[L - p].
editorial: The first piece has some length p. The remainder is an independent smaller rod. Trying every p and taking the max, with smaller lengths already solved, is the optimal substructure. dp[0] is 0. The answer is dp[n].

examples.explanation: A rod of length 8 is best cut for 22.
